hypotheses.construction_plan: Define F(a,b)=K(a,b). The piecewise expression is assembled by selecting the specialization F(n,m) on the condition Ne(n,m) and F(n,n) on the complementary True diagonal condition.
required_assumptions: K is a bivariate function accepting symbolic arguments n and m.
hypotheses.rationale: The two piecewise branches are the same underlying bivariate kernel K evaluated at (n,m) and at the diagonal point (n,n), so the non-identical branches are repeated specializations of one latent kernel.
